items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: There's the band, Ed McCarty. Yeah. And Frank Mutz. Mm-hmm. And Piggy Gerberk, Ellis Stratagas. Ellis Stratagas on trombone. And, uh, Eddie Powers and myself.

ctx.x: You know, right, like when you're going from Patterson, De Soto, go towards Canal Street, right in the next building was where the radio station was on the top. So I had a picture. The show, for the radio, was a live broadcast at that time.
Did he bring his accompanist in? Huh? Did he bring his piano player in with him or did he just... No, no. Eddie McCarthy, I'm not. He pretty much played piano. I see.

He sang some of the tunes that we were oysin' and all, got it all straight down with him, and, uh... And that's what happened. You know what this is? That's books of write-ups and stuff like that. Oh, yeah. I'll play with the Corsors Band Office. But I got these, I think, I think I... The other day I showed them to somebody. Yeah, here it is. Let's see it like that.
